lines.horror3d.item.herb_g.info: A medicinal plant. Mix it to make it stronger.
lines.horror3d.item.herb_r.info: Useless alone. Mixed with a green herb, it heals completely.
lines.horror3d.item.herb_gr.info: Green and red: it heals every wound.
lines.horror3d.item.ironkey.info: A heavy key. An iron lock is cast on its bow.
lines.horror3d.item.brasskey.info: A polished key with a brass lock engraved on it.
lines.horror3d.item.crank.info: A square-ended crank handle. It fits some mechanism.
lines.horror3d.say.intro: The east and west wings. Find a way out.
lines.horror3d.say.grille_rose: The grille rose. Something gleams behind it.
lines.horror3d.say.grille: An iron grille. A key gleams behind it, out of reach.
lines.horror3d.say.over: It is over. The way out is open.
lines.horror3d.say.sealed: Sealed with heavy chains. Something holds them from the far side.
lines.horror3d.say.locked_iron: It is locked. An iron lock.
lines.horror3d.say.locked_brass: It is locked. A brass lock.
lines.horror3d.say.no_room_box: No room. Leave something in the item box.
lines.horror3d.say.crank_fixed: The crank is fixed in place.
lines.horror3d.say.socket: A mechanism with a square socket. A crank would fit it.

notes.horror3d.boot: A step on the loading screen while the game builds the mansion.
notes.horror3d.item.herb_gg: Two green herbs mixed into one. G and R stand for green and red: keep them as the first letters of your words for the two colours.
notes.horror3d.item.herb_gr: A green herb and a red one mixed. G and R stand for green and red.
notes.horror3d.item.ironkey.info: The bow is the key's ring-shaped head: an iron lock is drawn on it, so it fits the door with an iron lock.
notes.horror3d.say.intro: The first message as the game starts, in the foyer of a mansion's east and west wings.
notes.horror3d.say.grille: An iron grille in the library hides the brass key; a crank raises it.
notes.horror3d.say.over: The monster in the gallery is dead and the sealed exit opens.
notes.horror3d.say.sealed: The exit door, sealed until the monster in the gallery is dead.
notes.horror3d.say.used: A key used on its door. {item} is the key's name in capitals (IRON KEY).
notes.horror3d.say.no_room_box: The six item slots are full: the item box in the foyer holds the rest.
notes.horror3d.say.took: An item picked up. {item} is its name in capitals (GREEN HERB); {count} how many (bullets come ten at a time), shown only when more than one.
notes.horror3d.say.socket: A mechanism on a post in the library: the crank fits it and raises the grille.
notes.horror3d.say.mix_with: On the items screen: MIX chosen, now pick the second item.
notes.horror3d.say.mixed: {item} is the new item's name (Mixed herbs (G+G)).
notes.horror3d.status.fine: The player's health, shown in a corner beside a heartbeat line, as in Resident Evil: fine, caution, danger.
notes.horror3d.hud.handgun: While aiming: the weapon, the bullets in the gun / the bullets carried.
notes.horror3d.hud.high: While aiming: the weapon (one of the two lines above) and the aim, raised (at a head). Two spaces between.
notes.horror3d.hud.low: While aiming: the weapon and the aim, lowered (at a dog).
notes.horror3d.hud.shake_free: A zombie holds the player: tap the button ({key}, its key or touch button) again and again to break free.
notes.horror3d.items.condition: The items screen's heading over the health status (FINE, CAUTION, DANGER).
notes.horror3d.items.handgun: The items screen: the weapon in hand, the bullets in the gun / the bullets carried. Two spaces after HANDGUN.
notes.horror3d.items.use: A small menu on an item in the items screen: use it, mix it with another, read about it. Keep the three short (about 5 letters).
notes.horror3d.box.yours: The item box screen: the left column is the player's six slots, the right column the box.
notes.horror3d.box.item: A row of the item box screen: an item's name, with how many when more than one (x10).
notes.horror3d.intro.continue: A menu when the game starts and a save exists: go on from the latest save, or start again.
notes.horror3d.touch.fire: The touch button that checks or attacks, while aiming the handgun: it fires. Keep it short.
notes.horror3d.room.foyer: The rooms' names, shown with a save in its slot (where it was made). West and east are the west and east halls.
notes.horror3d.over.found: The end screen after dying: how many things the player picked up. Another stat follows on the same row.
notes.horror3d.over.put_down_of: The end screen after dying: how many of the monsters were killed, of how many.
notes.horror3d.over.won: The title over the end screen when the player gets out of the mansion.
notes.horror3d.over.shots: The end screen after escaping: how many shots the player fired.
notes.action.act: A control's name on the controls screen, and in capitals on its touch button: check what is in front (a door, an item) or, while aiming, fire.
notes.action.aim: A control's name: hold it to aim the handgun.
notes.action.run: A control's name: hold it to run.
notes.action.swap: A control's name: swap between the handgun and the knife.
notes.action.items: A control's name: open the items screen.

brief: The 3D horror slice: the east and west wings of a dark mansion explored by flashlight, under fixed cameras, like Resident Evil or Alone in the Dark: zombies, dogs, few bullets, herbs to heal, keys and a crank, a typewriter to save, and something waiting in the gallery. The tone is quiet and grim; the messages are short, plain sentences that speak to the player as "you" (the player character is never named and never gendered in the words). Item names and the menus follow the games it pays homage to.
